references.text: The same warning that a foreigner (non-Levite) who approaches the tabernacle shall die, emphasizing the holiness requirements surrounding the tabernacle.
Reiterates that Aaron and his sons are to carry out the priestly service, and that a foreigner who approaches shall die.
Confirms that the priestly service is given to Aaron and his sons, and that a foreigner who approaches shall die.
Describes how Aaron and his sons are to serve before the Lord's presence in the tent of meeting.
Refers to the tabernacle and the tent of testimony for which Moses and Aaron were responsible.
The Levites are given to Aaron and his sons to perform service on behalf of the children of Israel and to protect them from plague.
The priests shall keep the Lord's statutes so that they do not incur sin and die.
